about_the_game:
A familiar fruit merge puzzle game where you drop fruit into a container, but with a naughty twist.  Instead of dropping fruit, you drop jiggly boobs wearing fruit themed bikinis!

Raising your score will reward you with nudity.

Story

You are a bartender on a nude beach resort.  It's your job to help new guests relax and become comfortable with their nudity.

Your special fruit mocktails have a special ability to expand the boob size of the guests AND dissolve their worries away... and their swimsuits :)

More Biggle, More Jiggle

The higher your score the bigger and more jiggly the boobs of your guest get.

Powerups

If the container gets too "stacked" you can use powerups to stay in the game. 
Maybe use a bomb to clear some space or a plasma ball to destroy all melons of the same fruit.
Maybe use the beach ball and see what happens...

It's not cheating.  Honest.

Gallery Rewards

There are 2 x gallery images to unlock for each guest as a reward.

Mastery

You get 1 x star for completing the level
If you are skilled you can earn additional stars for 

  • Complete the level under the limit

  • Merge a Megamelon (Watermelon) at least once.

Can you earn all 3 stars?
